current_gap: Global affine syndromes can certify some empty children but cannot compare two nonempty children in general. Any surviving high-width algorithm must use additional prefix-conditioned, counting, spectral, tensor, or other information beyond supports and global constant output parities.
result_obtained: A quantified no-go theorem for the complete global affine-syndrome certificate model, an exhaustive 256-function falsification gate with 92 opposite-decision complement pairs, a no-common-avoider pair theorem, and a high-width minimal-stretch lift.

surviving_route: syndrome-based zero detection on forced prefixes, plus certificate models containing additional prefix-conditioned/counting information
stop_rule: Close the global affine-syndrome comparison-certificate front after the formal collision theorem.
